limitations: No deposited sample-to-file table; genotype mapping from file names, RAW headers, .msf search-time names and the paper.
150828 26-30 genotype background (WT vs SimpleCell) conflicts between RAW header and deposited/search-time names; deposited name and paper followed.
'GM3363' in file names interpreted as Coriell GM23363 by exact POMT1 variant match.
Only the first 6 MB of 9 .msf files were read; deamidation listed in PRIDE protocol not found in searches and omitted.
Age, ancestry, passage number and fibroblast culture medium not reported.
Supplementary tables of the paper were not accessed.
